steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Why can't I go out, Uncle?

steps.name: Chester
steps.text: By the president's orders, you are not to go running around until he returns.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: So when's he coming back?

steps.name: Chester
steps.text: The president is currently making his way to Karlan, and will be back in two days' time.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Look, I just want to catch a breath of fresh air, okay?

steps.name: Chester
steps.text: If you'll stay around the estate... I'll send someone to follow you.

steps.name: Chester
steps.text: Ensia, this is for your own good. The situation in Kjerag is precarious right now.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: *Sigh*...

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Do you really need to do all this... Enciodes?

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Doctor, what should I do...?

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Aurora?!

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: Shhh–– Keep it down, it was really hard for me to sneak in with all the guards.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Weren't you and Sharp going to stay with the Doctor?

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: Yes. I'm here because the Doctor wanted me to tell you something.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: You're absolutely sure?

steps.name: Monch
steps.text: Yes, Arctosz has assembled a large number of soldiers in his territory, but he's not the one leading them – the Doctor is.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Where's Arctosz?

steps.name: Monch
steps.text: I'm not sure... From eyewitness accounts, he disappeared after formally handing leadership of his forces to the Doctor.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Is that Doctor's squad the bait? No, it can't be that simple.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: How about their numbers?

steps.name: Monch
steps.text: The Paleroche clansmen who responded to Arctosz's call were mostly what you expected. Based on our estimates, Arctosz shouldn't have enough men to assemble another squad.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: But there's no chance he's sitting in the back. There's a high possibility of there being another team.

steps.name: Monch
steps.text: The Paleroche clan's warriors are skilled at operating in the mountains. It's not beyond the realm of possibility.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: They can't leave this squad alone though, regardless of whether it's a decoy or the main force.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Let Weiss pass on the orders and have the troops gather at the base of the mountain, awaiting further instructions.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Then dispatch someone to keep track of the army. Your primary responsibility is to find Arctosz.

steps.name: Monch
steps.text: On it.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: The Doctor... wants me to climb up the mountain and sneak into the Vine-Bead Court to find my sister?

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: Correct.

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: Because conflict between the Paleroche and Silverash clans is almost unavoidable now.

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: But if there's one person who can put a stop to all of this, it's your sister, the Saintess, Enya Silverash.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: But... But...

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: The Doctor wanted to stick to Rhodes Island's policy of nonintervention and stand by.

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: But since restoring the Saintess to power was just a ploy by Mr. Enciodes, the Doctor believes he doesn't care much for Kjerag's faith.

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: And once the Silverash clan's forces beat down the Paleroche clan's, the only thing stopping him from taking all of Kjerag is the Vine-Bead Court.

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: In other words, the object of faith for all the people of Kjerag – the Saintess.

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: The Doctor doesn't actually need you to convince the Saintess to do anything. The basic idea is there might be a way to heal the relationship between your brother and sister.

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: There might also be some guilt in there for not being able to help since coming to Kjerag.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: I'd never blame the Doctor for that! I just want to apologize, both to the Doctor and everyone else who came with me. This was supposed to be a nice vacation, but my brother went and screwed everything up...

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: It's not your fault either, Cliffheart.

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: Anyway, the Doctor's been dragged into Enciodes's business, and can't stand on the sidelines anymore.

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: And anyway, you're Enciodes's sister. Nothing can change that.

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: So the Doctor's decided to make a move.

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: And it's to have you go up the mountain, and become a kind of insurance beside the Saintess.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: The Doctor wants me to stop my brother's plans when the time comes.

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: Or, take the Saintess and run when the time comes.
Ensia subconsciously rubs the coil of rope in her hand.
Her sister braided it for her when she was a child.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: I'll go.

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: This is a covert operation. I'll be there with the other operators to help.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: I have a better idea.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Just get me to the base of Mount Karlan. I'll handle the rest myself.

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: Doctor, why are you marching us at such a slow pace?

options: So as to give those prying eyes their fill.
We can't go any faster. Not right now.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Gulo, don't tell me you still haven't figured out what we're doing?

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: Aren't we drawing the attention of the Silverash clan? I think we're going a bit too slow for that.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: I see you're eager to just rush in and fight the Silverashes.

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: Sure am.

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: Last time, Valais handed me my ass, so I've got a chip on my shoulder.

steps.name: Paleroche Clan Warrior
steps.text: Doctor, we've confirmed the location of Yucatan, who was taken away during the ceremony.

steps.name: Paleroche Clan Warrior
steps.text: As you suspected, she was not taken to the Silverash clan's territory, but locked up at the base of the mountain.

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: Doctor, you really are something else. You managed to find Old Yucatan this quickly.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Hmph. Such simple intelligence gathering is child's play for a Browntail.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Anyway, we've found Yucatan, so it's time for me and this idiot here to get moving, right?

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: What's with the silent treatment?

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: What, were you talking to me? I don't remember my folks ever calling me 'Idiot.'

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: (Sighs deeply)

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: General! Gulo! Hmph... You happy now?

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: I'm asking you, do you know what you're supposed to be doing?

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: Of course. Head to the nearest station, cause some chaos, and give you a chance to rescue your man.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Good.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: But a word of warning from the Doctor –– don't actually kill anyone.

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: Hmph. The station's full of civilians. I swear on my name not to lay a finger on them.

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: But, Doctor, if the Silverashes show up...

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: All I can say is, I'll try to hold back.

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: Cliffheart, did you say you were looking for... your mountaineering equipment?

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Yup.

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: Don't tell me you're going to climb Mount Karlan...

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Eh... From what you've told me, there should be a ton of people in Karlan.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: If we're talking about heading up the face of the mountain, even the squad leader would have some difficulty sneaking in.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: But that's nothing I can't handle~

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: As long as you can get me to the foot of the mountain, I can handle the rest.

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: But... the others and I won't be able to protect you.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: No biggie, no biggie.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: I've gotten plenty of training at Rhodes Island, so I'm more than capable of handling myself in an ordinary fight.

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Chester
steps.text: Ensia, where are you going?

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Uncle Chester...

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: I want to go climbing.

steps.name: Chester
steps.text: Which mountain are we talking here?

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Mount Karlan.

steps.name: Chester
steps.text: That place is going to turn into a battlefield. You'll get hurt if you go.

steps.name: Chester
steps.text: Why do you want to go there?

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Uncle Chester, ever since I fell in love with mountaineering, I've always wanted to summit Mount Karlan with my own two hands.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: I've only wanted it even more since my sister left us and became the Saintess... One day, I would reach the peak and bring my sister home.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: And now, my chance has finally come.

steps.name: Chester
steps.text: You won't be able to do that, Ensia.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Even if I can't bring my sister back home, I need to be with her at a time like this.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: She must be very confused after everything our brother's done.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: If I can't stop him, then, I at least want to be there for her!
Olafur, your youngest daughter's gotten pretty big too.

steps.name: Silverash Clan Sergeant
steps.text: Young Lady, I am sorry, but by the Master's orders, you are not allowed to leave the estate. It's for your own safety.

steps.name: Chester
steps.text: Stand down.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Uncle Chester!

steps.name: Silverash Clan Sergeant
steps.text: Sir, you're directly contradicting the Master's orders!

steps.name: Chester
steps.text: I'll accept all responsibility for what happens here.

steps.name: Silverash Clan Sergeant
steps.text: But... Even if you'll go so far to vouch for her, how can that be more important than her safety?

steps.name: Chester
steps.text: A Silverash never takes unnecessary risks.

steps.name: Chester
steps.text: This time, let's trust her.

steps.name: Silverash Clan Sergeant
steps.text: Ugh... Fine.

steps.name: Chester
steps.text: Go, prepare a burdenbeast for the Young Lady and our guests from Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Silverash Clan Sergeant
steps.text: Understood.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Thank you, Uncle Chester!

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: Thank you very much, Sir.

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: I always thought you...

steps.name: Chester
steps.text: No need to thank me.

steps.name: Chester
steps.text: Now go. Time is of the essence.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Okay!

steps.name: Chester
steps.text: Ensia.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Chester
steps.text: Be careful out there.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Will do!

steps.name: Chester
steps.text: Olafur.

steps.name: Chester
steps.text: Ever since you and Elizabeth passed on, I've always regretted that I stood against you and the reforms you tried to bring to our land. I should have stood with you.

steps.name: Chester
steps.text: So, when your son decided to take up your ideals, I chose to support him wholeheartedly.

steps.name: Chester
steps.text: Enciodes has done exceptionally well.

steps.name: Chester
steps.text: As the Saintess, Enya has won the adoration of the people of Kjerag.

steps.name: Chester
steps.text: Though Ensia contracted Oripathy, her condition is under control and she is as happy-go-lucky as always.

steps.name: Chester
steps.text: But, it suddenly just occurred to me.
How long has it been since I saw these three kids getting along, smiling and laughing as siblings should?

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Great Elder, you still need to rest...

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: According to the records, this great hall was built by the people of all three clans following the establishment of the Tri-Clan Council. The existence and cooperation of the three clans far predates the modern Tri-Clan system.

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: Then, after thousands of years passed, the system was tweaked and sanded down, until it became what we see today.

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: And this chair may well have been here for thousands of years.

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: Over a dozen Great Elders sat on this seat, spending their lives here.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Juast as a dozen Saintesses found their final resting spot atop this mountain.

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: From the very beginning, the Saintess was a fabrication of the Vine-Bead Court to facilitate the spread of the faith.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Now that you've chosen to tell me these things I've known for a long time, are you meaning to say that our faith is false?

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: You seem to be a lot more direct as well. But I mean the opposite, Enya. Sorry, Saintess.

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: Saintess... *cough* *cough*... Do you know my original name?

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: I'm afraid no one in the present Vine-Bead Court remembers either.

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: Even I, myself, have forgotten.

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: Each Great Elder, after taking up the mantle of the previous one, is known only as 'Great Elder'.

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: One day, the people will also forget your name, and know you only as 'Saintess'.

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: Then, the Great Elder and Saintess come to realize––

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: What people believe in... is not Kjeragandr.

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: People can believe in anything, as long as there's a story, a few neat coincidences. They will believe in you, in me, in Enciodes, in the mountain, in the water, even in a single leaf.

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: If people can believe in anything, then what is faith?

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: The Great Elders finally came to an answer:

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: What people believe is faith itself.

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: People choose to vest power in the object of their faith.

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: People attribute the things that they shun to their faith.

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: People unconditionally trust the way of life to which their faith guides them.

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: So, what is faith?

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: Faith is laziness, escapism, and decadence! Faith is stability, faith is stagnation! *cough* *cough* *cough*––

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Let's get you to bed, Great Elder.

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: No, Saintess. Saintess!
The Great Elder desperately clutches at Enya's wrist.
His grasp is so tight that it leaves a red mark on her skin, as if he spent all his remaining strength on it.
His eyes are fixed on the Saintess before him, but he seems to be looking at someone else.

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: Faith is ugly! But even so, it is indestructible!

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: In the thousands of years of Kjerag's history, the cracks between the three major clans have gradually widened, yet no one can deny faith. Faith is the foundation of Kjerag!

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: Faith unites the people of Kjerag. People seek out faith, people rely on faith!

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: Kjerag has existed like this for thousands of years!

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: The people crave stability! The people crave stagnation!

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: Enciodes thinks he has won, but he hasn't. He cannot win.

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: How could he possibly defeat the faith that has coalesced in Kjerag for millennia?

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: This old man is about to die, but you are still young. You are the Saintess of this Vine-Bead Court, and you will become the Great Elder of this Vine-Bead Court.

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: Go forth and instruct him, overcome him. Make him understand that in the face of faith itself, his actions are insignificant, beneath even mention!
Enya remains silent for a while, but forces herself free of the Great Elder's grip.
She feels pity for the old man before her, but she feels a greater determination.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: ...I disagree, Great Elder.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: You say that faith equals stagnation, and that people depend on faith because they demand stability.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: But that's not how I see things.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: It is true that once people accept a faith, they come to rely on it. Laziness, escapism, decadence... I can't argue those.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: But this does not mean that faith itself is stagnation.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Faith is just faith, nothing more. It has no attributes by itself, and its substance comes from what is put into it.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: If the faith progresses, then the faithful will progress with it.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: If the faith stagnates, then the faithful will stagnate with it.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: The reason why you think the people of Kjerag crave stagnation is precisely because Kjeragandr's faith has been stagnant for thousands of years in the hands of the Vine-Bead Court!

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: We've drawn up this land as a prison to preserve the rules of some ancient agreement, surviving in these snow-capped mountains for millennia without exploring or even making contact with the outside world.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: And you mean to tell me this agreement has anything to do with our faith?

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Is it not just the arrogance of the Vine-Bead Court?

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: Arrogance? No, no, this is how things were meant to be!

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Nothing is inherently meant to be.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: If it seems that way, it's only because it's never been changed.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: It's time to change, Great Elder.

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: No, Saintess, you cannot change anything.

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: Faith... *cough* *cough*... is the fundamental reason why Kjerag is Kjerag.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: I will go and face Enciodes, but not in the way you want.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: I don't know if I'll succeed.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: But, since the Saintess has always been used by the Vine-Bead Court as a tool to guide the peoples' faith...

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: I shall put this tool to good use.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: I am the Saintess, but I am not the Saintess of the Vine-Bead Court. I am the Saintess of Kjerag.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: I will use my own methods to guide the people to freedom. The freedom to progress, to explore, to take risks.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: And as for you, Great Elder, it is time to rest.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Attendants, come help the Great Elder away.
Enya stands up and walks to the door of the great hall, her eyes fixed forward.
Behind her, the Great Elder occupies his same seat, watching her back grow ever smaller in the distance. He stretches out his hand as to grasp something, but finally, powerlessly, it drops.
He grasps nothing at all.
He remains there evermore, motionless, just like the snow of Kjerag blanketing his dreams.
